name: omg-apps
description: Build and publish full-stack apps and games from chat, with a database, sign-in and live updates between users.

interface.shortDescription: Build and share apps by link
interface.longDescription: Describe an app or a game and get a live link you can share. Every app has a database, sign-in and live updates between everyone who opens it, so votes, boards, chats and two-player games work from the first version. Apps are hosted at your-app.omgs.app.
defaultPrompt: Make a team vote app that everyone with the link can use, with live counts
Make a two-player tic-tac-toe game I can play with a friend on our phones
Make a guestbook where people sign in and leave a message
capabilities: Build and publish web apps and games
Shared data and live updates between users

positive.prompt: Make a team vote app. Anyone with the link can add an option and vote, and everyone sees the counts update live. Publish it and give me a link I can share.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes an app at https://<slug>.omgs.app. A vote in one browser shows in a second browser without a reload. The app opens without sign-in.

positive.prompt: Make a two-player tic-tac-toe game. I send a link to a friend, we each open it on our own phone, and we play live against each other.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes a game with a room link. A second player joins from the link, and each move appears on the other screen.

positive.prompt: Make a guestbook. People sign in, then leave a short message. Everyone can read all messages, and each person can delete only their own.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes a guestbook. Reading works without sign-in. Posting asks the visitor to sign in. The server refuses a delete from anyone except the author.

positive.prompt: Add a reset button to the vote app that clears all votes.
positive.expected_behavior: Deploys a new version of the same app with the same link, using the projectId from the first deploy.

positive.prompt: Is my vote app ready yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Building, Live or Build failed and shows the app card with an Open app button. A failed build includes the error.

negative.prompt: Explain what a React hook is.
Build an iOS app and submit it to the App Store.
Summarize this article about interest rates.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: build and publish full-stack web apps and games from chat, with a database, sign-in, live updates and an in-chat app card.
